response.text:
# Candidate Assessment: DOC_resume_ninety vs. DOC_posting_ten_five

**Result: 90% mandatory match. Proceed** (threshold is 85%).

## Mandatory requirements

| # | Requirement | Resume evidence | Match |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Python | Languages: Python | ✅ |
| 2 | SQL | Languages: SQL | ✅ |
| 3 | Linux administration | Platform: Linux administration | ✅ |
| 4 | Git | Platform: Git | ✅ |
| 5 | REST API design | Services: REST API design | ✅ |
| 6 | Unit testing | Services: unit testing | ✅ |
| 7 | CI pipelines | Services: CI pipelines | ✅ |
| 8 | Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm | Infrastructure: all five listed | ✅ |
| 9 | Kafka | Streaming: Kafka | ✅ |
| 10 | GraphQL | Not mentioned | ❌ |

**Score: 9 of 10 = 90%**

**How item 8 was counted:** It bundles five tools under one number. Scoring each tool separately gives 13 of 14 skills, or about 92.9%. Both methods exceed 85%, so the decision is the same either way.

## Gap
- **GraphQL** is the only missing mandatory skill. Since the candidate has strong REST API design experience, it would be worth asking about GraphQL exposure in an interview.

## Nice-to-have
None of the five items appear on the resume: Grafana, Prometheus, technical writing, mentoring, public speaking. As instructed, this doesn't affect the outcome. It may still be useful context: Grafana and Prometheus fit naturally with the candidate's Kubernetes background and could be learned quickly.

## Decision
**Proceed.** The candidate meets the 85% mandatory threshold.
